lede: Mode Mode is a studio for spatial, physical, and digital work — a shared field where each project is a mode of the same practice.

sections.body: A studio run by Julia and Matt. We design experiences that move between screens, objects, and rooms: haunted mansions and arcade cabinets, streaming spectacles and printed matter. The homepage is a live field map — every project is a cloud of positions across two axes, Digital ↔ Physical and Object ↔ Spatial, and overlap reads as density rather than category. This page is the plain-language version of that map.

One idea, authored across modes. We treat the medium as a setting on the same instrument — the same concept re-voiced as an installation, a video, a game, a booth. Nothing is a deliverable in isolation; each project is a station in a longer walk.
Eyeknow Manor · Nightmare Kart · GIF · 65 Porter · Massive · Selected Arcade. Open any of them from the index, bottom-left, or the field map on the home page.
